notes.title: Release date set! 1 Sep 2025
notes.notes:
Hello! Release date for the first public version has been set. It's just the begining and the first time this game is public. Your feedback will be key during this first stage!  Here's the full list of current implemented features.



Physics based simulations including Buoyancy, Hidrodynamics, Aerodynamics, Suspensions and Wheels.

Sails Simulation for squared and triangular Sails.

Expanding Open Wold.

3 Main Islands and secondary locations.

Weather simulation and 3d clouds.

Full 24hs day cycles with calendar.

Dynamic Wind effects on enviroment and physics. 

NPC citizens, Residences and Industries.

Passengers and cargo transport capability.

Transport Jobs offers from Industries. (currently the only way to earn coins).

Player buyable Residences in 3 initial tiers in Lumen and Cancrorum Islands.

Vehicles and states Deeds system.

Vehicle retrieve system. 

Grabbable Items and Cargo.

Manually load and unload vehicles. 

4 types of Carts on initial version. (more on the way)

Horse riding and Cart pulling.

1 Row boat.

2 Small squared Sail boats. 

1 Latin Sail Ship. (medium)

1 Sloop Ship. (medium)

1 Cutter Ship. (big)

1 Brig. (huge)

Items based Inventory system.

Permanent local data (Steam Cloud to be confirmed)

Avatar customization (female and male)

Network co-op capability. (you join someone else game via IP)

Network trading with players can be done by droping and picking up Items, except Deeds.

Player locality, user can walk seamlessly over moving vehicles.

Text to Voice chat over network. 

Text to voice NPC interactions

Text Voice Tutorials.



And more to be added. I will publish planned features once published. This list may get bigger by the 1st of Sep.
